record.original_question: For a given numerical semigroup S, let T range over all numerical semigroups with S = T/2. Find a formula, depending only on S, for the minimum Frobenius number among those doubles T.

evidence.quote: In the just quoted work we raise the question of finding a formula that depends on S and allows us to compute the minimum of the Frobenius numbers of the doubles of S.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A numerical semigroup is a subset $S \subseteq \mathbb{N}_{0}$ that is closed under addition, contains $0$, and has finite complement $\mathbb{N}_{0}\setminus S$. The Frobenius number $F(S)$ is the largest integer not belonging to $S$ (defined when $S \ne \mathbb{N}_{0}$). For a numerical semigroup $T$ and a positive integer $d$, the quotient is $T/d := \{n \in \mathbb{N}_{0} : dn \in T\}$, which is again a numerical semigroup. A numerical semigroup $T$ is called a double of a numerical semigroup $S$ when $S = T/2$, i.e. $T = \{n \in \mathbb{N}_{0} : 2n \in T\text{ implies } n \in S\}$ — equivalently, $\{2s : s \in S\} \subseteq T$ and an integer $n$ lies in $S$ iff $2n \in T$.

Problem. Given a numerical semigroup $S$, let $\mathcal{D}(S) = \{T : T \text{ is a numerical semigroup with } T/2 = S\}$. Find a closed-form expression, depending only on invariants of $S$, for
$$\min_{T \in \mathcal{D}(S)} F(T).$$
artifact.status_search_result: A related problem on minimum genus among d-folds of a numerical semigroup was solved by Moscariello (arXiv:1512.00638), giving the formula g + ⌈(d-1)f/2⌉. However, that work concerns the genus, not the Frobenius number, and does not appear to provide the analogous closed formula for the minimum Frobenius number among doubles. No source found explicitly resolving the Frobenius-number version, so the status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: Minimal genus of a multiple and Frobenius number of a quotient of a numerical semigroup
status_evidence.snippet: The minimal genus of the d-folds of S is g + ⌈(d-1)f/2⌉; resolves a question of Robles-Pérez, Rosales, and Vasco for genus.
status_evidence.claim: A closely related minimum-genus question was resolved, but the minimum-Frobenius-number version for doubles is not addressed there.
